caption: The drawing features a vertically oriented rectangular object composed of two main sections stacked one above the other, placed centrally on a plain, off-white background. The upper section consists of alternating horizontal wavy stripes in brick red, medium blue, and a thin beige line, with the blue color occupying the most space. The lower section has alternating horizontal wavy stripes of brick red, olive green, and a darker brown, with olive green and brown forming the majority of the pattern. Handwritten notations appear at the lower left margin in black and red pencil, and there are faint, illegible pencil markings near the bottom. The rest of the page is unmarked.
title: Shaker Rug
